title: Young Boba Fett in the Aftermath of Battle
description: As Boba Fett recovers in his bacta pod, memories of his life run through his head. Many years ago, under the service of the Separatists, Boba travelled to the planet Geonosis with his father, Jango. During the ceremony to execute Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Padmé Amidala, Jedi forces arrived to rescue the trio, and a full-scale battle exploded. Jango Fett, locked in combat with Mace Windu, was defeated by the Jedi Master. In the aftermath, a young Boba picked up Jango's helmet, and grieved the loss of his father.
